title.zh: Kalshi Asks CFTC to Approve a Never-Expiring WTI Crude Futures Contract
title.en: Kalshi Asks CFTC to Approve a Never-Expiring WTI Crude Futures Contract

current_state.zh: Kalshi has filed with the CFTC to list a never-expiring WTI crude oil futures contract, which if approved within 45 days would be the first crude perpetual on a US-regulated platform, trading 24 hours a day five days a week.
current_state.en: Kalshi has filed with the CFTC to list a never-expiring WTI crude oil futures contract, which if approved within 45 days would be the first crude perpetual on a US-regulated platform, trading 24 hours a day five days a week.
